audience: finance and ecommerce teams who calculate and record sales tax and VAT with Numeral

useCases.title: Get a tax quote for an order
useCases.text: The AI sends a customer address and line items and gets per-jurisdiction rates, total tax and totals. The quote is not saved.

useCases.title: Record a completed sale as a transaction
useCases.text: The AI calculates the tax for an order, then records the sale as a transaction using the calculation id and your order id.

useCases.title: Look up a transaction and its refunds
useCases.text: The AI reads a recorded transaction with its line items and currencies, and lists the refunds recorded against it.

useCases.title: Record a full or partial refund
useCases.text: The AI records a refund against a transaction: the whole sale, or only chosen line items. This adjusts the tax owed.

useCases.title: Check products and tax categories, or add a product
useCases.text: The AI lists your products with their reference id and tax category, and reads one product. It can create a product with a tax category.

useCases.title: Look up or add a customer
useCases.text: The AI reads a customer by Numeral id or by your own reference id, with name, email and tax-exempt status. It can also add a customer.
